card.name: Approximation words before a quantity
card.fires_on: Words like over, about, approximately or between that sit right before a number and its unit. They often follow verbs such as weighing, lasts, lose or receiving.

modes.label: Weight thresholds
modes.description: The word over after weighing, introducing a weight cutoff.
modes.example: One 250 mg mefloquine hydrochloride tablet should be taken once weekly in pediatric patients weighing<< over>> 45 kg.

modes.label: Approximate amounts
modes.description: About or approximately before a number for duration, size or dose.
modes.example: diuresis begins within 2 hours, peaks in about 4 hours and lasts<< about>> 6 to 12 hours.

modes.label: Range or speed
modes.description: Over or between before a quantity in general text.
modes.example: streaming away from the galaxy center at speeds of<< over>> 1,000 kilometers per
